fields.FIR_Description: As per the FIR recorded on 2025-03-30, the complainant parked a silver car bearing registration number TN-01-XX-1075 near Sindhu Puram Industrial Area and found the parking spot empty the next morning. The time of the incident was given as 01:25 on 2025-03-30. Lavanya Ammal approached Salem Town PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000175. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. The complainant could not identify the person involved. Potentially relevant material referenced includes physical documents, CCTV footage and a vehicle observation.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: Physical document; CCTV footage; Vehicle observation
fields.Modus_Operandi: Car reportedly taken from an unattended parking area.
